siteDescription: Molly E. Brown is a Research Professor at the University of Maryland whose research connects satellite Earth observation, climate and socioeconomic data to understand risks to agriculture, food security and human well-being.

home.earthToDecisionsText: A satellite measures reflected light; a family decides whether it can afford grain. Between the two lies a chain of evidence — environmental conditions, harvests, markets and health — that Brown's research has traced for more than two decades, and a set of institutions, from famine early warning networks to insurers and mission teams, that turn that evidence into action.
